title: Nemotron-Cascade: Scaling Cascaded Reinforcement Learning for General-Purpose Reasoning Models
paper_type_zh: 级联强化学习技术报告与工件发布
best_for_zh: 审计按领域 RLVR 课程、公开工件与训练谱系边界的读者
one_line: Nemotron-Cascade documents and partially releases a two-stage SFT plus RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math -> Code -> SWE cascade, with stage-specific feedback ranging from a scalar RM to tests and patch-similarity judging, but complete data-to-run lineage is unavailable.
Nemotron-Cascade 报告了 SFT 和 RLHF 之后按领域顺序开展的 RL，并提供 NVIDIA 的模型/数据工件，但逐领域反馈合约与端到端审计谱系仍不完整。
why: It lets the frontier-report track audit weights, datasets, feedback contracts, intermediate checkpoints, and benchmark results as separate evidence layers instead of treating a collection page as proof of full reproducibility.
inclusion_reason: A frontier report with unusually explicit stage-specific data and feedback contracts, official weights, a reward model, intermediate checkpoints, and multiple datasets; it is also a useful audit case because the public collection does not fully reconcile every described training stage or release count.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Nemotron-Cascade addresses a concrete systems problem in general-purpose reasoning post-training: math, instruction following, competitive programming, and software repair differ sharply in response length, reward latency, verifier cost, and failure modes. A single blended RL batch therefore couples infrastructure and hyperparameters that are appropriate for different domains. The report proposes handling that heterogeneity by training one domain at a time.

The primary source is arXiv:2512.13607, first submitted on 15 December 2025 and revised as v2 on 27 March 2026. The paper starts from Qwen3-8B-Base or Qwen3-14B-Base, performs two-stage SFT, then applies RLHF, instruction-following RL, Math RL, Code RL, and SWE RL in sequence. The core data object is consequently not one dataset: it is a chain of supervised conversations, preference pairs, RL prompt sets, expected answers or patches, online policy responses, and stage-specific reward signals.

For the atlas, the decision boundary is disclosure rather than leaderboard position. NVIDIA releases final weights, 8B intermediate checkpoints, a 72B reward model, and several SFT/RL datasets in an official collection. This Card asks which artifacts correspond to reported stages, what each feedback contract verifies, and which links remain unknown. Benchmark performance is kept as model evidence and is not used to infer data quality or full reproducibility.

Nemotron-Cascade 针对通用推理后训练中的一个具体系统问题：数学、指令遵循、竞赛编程与软件修复在回答长度、奖励延迟、验证成本和失败方式上差异明显。若把所有领域混入同一批 RL 数据，基础设施与超参数就必须同时适配彼此不同的任务。报告因此主张按领域依次训练。

主要来源是 arXiv:2512.13607，初稿提交于 2025 年 12 月 15 日，v2 修订于 2026 年 3 月 27 日。论文从 Qwen3-8B-Base 或 Qwen3-14B-Base 出发，先进行两阶段 SFT，再依次执行 RLHF、指令遵循 RL、Math RL、Code RL 和 SWE RL。因此，核心数据对象不是单一数据集，而是一条由监督对话、偏好对、RL 提示集、期望答案或补丁、在线策略回答与分阶段奖励信号组成的链条。

对本图谱而言，判断边界是披露程度，而不是排行榜名次。NVIDIA 在官方 collection 中发布最终权重、8B 中间检查点、72B 奖励模型以及多组 SFT/RL 数据。本卡需要核对哪些工件对应哪些报告阶段、各反馈契约实际验证什么，以及哪些连接仍为 unknown。基准成绩只作为模型行为证据，不用于推断数据质量或完整可复现性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: replace joint multi-domain RL with a fixed cascade whose data, rollout budget, and feedback contract are specialized by stage. After two-stage SFT, the reported order is RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math RL -> Code RL -> SWE RL. General alignment is trained before narrower verifiable domains, and response/context budgets expand where longer reasoning or repository context is required.

The feedback object changes at every step. RLHF assigns a scalar score with Qwen2.5-CascadeRL-RM-72B. IF-RL checks explicit instruction constraints and dynamically removes prompts that provide no gradient. Math RL gives binary answer reward using the AceMath verifier, with an additional code-switching penalty. Code RL executes generated programs and rewards only all-tests-passed outputs. SWE RL does not execute patches: it combines Unidiff lexical similarity with Kimi-Dev-72B semantic comparison against the human patch.

This stage-specific design is the reason for inclusion in frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger. It exposes more of the feedback chain than a weights-only report and provides 8B checkpoints after SFT, RLHF, IF-RL, Math RL, and Code RL. The relevant comparison is not whether Cascade RL uses a new optimizer--it uses strict on-policy GRPO in verl--but whether separating heterogeneous domains makes the recipe and its failure surfaces easier to inspect.

一句话概括其贡献：把联合多领域 RL 改为固定级联，并让每个阶段使用专门的数据、rollout 预算与反馈契约。两阶段 SFT 之后，报告顺序为 RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math RL -> Code RL -> SWE RL。训练先处理通用对齐，再进入更窄的可验证领域；需要更长推理或仓库上下文时，再扩展回答或输入预算。

反馈对象随阶段变化。RLHF 由 Qwen2.5-CascadeRL-RM-72B 给出标量分数；IF-RL 检查明确的指令约束，并动态移除无法提供梯度的提示；Math RL 用 AceMath 验证器给出二元答案奖励，同时加入语言切换惩罚；Code RL 执行生成程序，只有通过全部测试才奖励；SWE RL 不执行补丁，而是把 Unidiff 词法相似度与 Kimi-Dev-72B 对人工补丁的语义比较结合起来。

这种分阶段设计正是它进入 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger 的原因。与只发布权重的报告相比，它公开了更多反馈链条，并提供 SFT、RLHF、IF-RL、Math RL 与 Code RL 之后的 8B 检查点。重要比较并不是 Cascade RL 是否发明了新优化器——它在 verl 中使用严格 on-policy GRPO——而是领域分离能否让配方与失败面更容易审计。

title: Method
方法
html:
SFT has two length stages. Stage 1 trains for one epoch at 16K on general-domain data and thinking-only math, code, and science responses. Stage 2 trains for one epoch at 32K, recombining general data with longer math/code/science traces, tool-calling conversations, instruction-following records, and SWE localization, repair, and test-generation examples. DeepSeek-R1 is the main Stage-1 reasoning generator; DeepSeek-R1-0528 generates longer Stage-2 reasoning and SWE responses; DeepSeek-V3 variants provide general-domain modes; Qwen3-235B-A22B supplies tool-calling responses.

Construction is domain-specific. Math SFT uses AceReason-Nemotron-1.1-derived prompts, length filtering, multiple teacher responses, and 9-gram benchmark filtering. Code SFT draws from TACO, APPS, OpenCoder-Stage-2, and OpenCodeReasoning, deduplicates prompts, generates multiple responses, and applies 9-gram filtering. Science combines S1K and Llama-Nemotron post-training sources, rejects option-analysis-style questions, synthesizes rarer variants, and performs benchmark filtering. SWE uses SWE-Bench-Train, SWE-Fixer-Train, SWE-reBench, and SWE-Smith; repositories appearing in SWE-bench Verified are removed, and cross-source duplicates are matched by repository plus base commit.

The RL scaffold is strict on-policy GRPO in verl. Each iteration samples a response group from the current policy and performs one update; importance ratio is therefore one. The objective uses group-normalized rewards and token-level loss with no KL term. The cascade is RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math RL -> Code RL -> SWE RL. RLHF uses preference-data prompts with math and competitive programming removed. IF-RL uses two progressively harder constraint taxonomies. Math RL filters unsuitable, noisy, trivial, and unsolved questions. Code RL filters special-judge tasks, weak tests, duplicates, benchmark overlaps, trivial problems, and problems unsolved by the stronger difficulty model.

SWE separates easier supervised instances from harder RL instances by patch-similarity success among DeepSeek-R1-0528 samples. RL prompts contain ground-truth localization files, optionally mixed with noisy retrieved files; short prompts are discarded. The reward combines lexical and Kimi-Dev-72B semantic similarity to the human patch, so no Docker execution is used during SWE RL. For 8B, input context extends from 16K to 24K while output remains 16K; 14B uses a 32K input and 16K output.

The public collection verifies many inputs and checkpoints but not a complete run. It visibly includes Stage-1/Stage-2 SFT, SFT-SWE, RL-Math, RL-SWE, RL-RLHF, RM-Training, final weights, a 72B RM, and 8B intermediate checkpoints. Dedicated IF-RL and Code-RL datasets, exact verl commits/configurations, policy rollout groups, component rewards, dynamic-filter ledgers, seeds, and optimizer states are unknown.

SFT 分为两个长度阶段。Stage 1 在 16K 上训练一个 epoch，数据包括通用领域以及仅含 thinking 模式的数学、代码和科学回答。Stage 2 在 32K 上训练一个 epoch，把通用数据与更长的数学、代码、科学轨迹、工具调用对话、指令遵循记录，以及 SWE 定位、修复和测试生成样本重新混合。DeepSeek-R1 是 Stage 1 的主要推理生成器；DeepSeek-R1-0528 生成更长的 Stage 2 推理与 SWE 回答；DeepSeek-V3 系列提供通用领域的两种回答模式；Qwen3-235B-A22B 生成工具调用回答。

构造过程按领域分别设计。数学 SFT 使用源自 AceReason-Nemotron-1.1 的提示，进行长度筛选、多教师回答生成与 9-gram 基准过滤。代码 SFT 来自 TACO、APPS、OpenCoder-Stage-2 和 OpenCodeReasoning，先去重，再生成多个回答并执行 9-gram 过滤。科学部分结合 S1K 与 Llama-Nemotron 后训练来源，删除只分析选项的问题，合成较少见的问题变体，并进行基准过滤。SWE 使用 SWE-Bench-Train、SWE-Fixer-Train、SWE-reBench 与 SWE-Smith；来自 SWE-bench Verified 仓库的实例会被排除，跨来源重复项按仓库名与 base commit 匹配。

RL 框架是在 verl 中执行的严格 on-policy GRPO。每轮由当前策略采样一组回答并更新一次，因此重要性比率为一；目标使用组内归一化奖励、token 级损失且不含 KL 项。级联顺序为 RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math RL -> Code RL -> SWE RL。RLHF 从偏好数据中取提示，并排除数学与竞赛编程；IF-RL 使用两套逐渐变难的约束分类；Math RL 删除不适合验证、噪声、过易与不可解题目；Code RL 删除特殊评测、测试不足、重复、基准重叠、过易以及强难度模型也无法解出的任务。

SWE 根据 DeepSeek-R1-0528 多次采样后的补丁相似度，把较易实例分给 SFT、较难实例分给 RL。RL 提示包含人工定位文件，也可混入检索得到的噪声文件；过短提示会被删除。奖励结合词法相似度与 Kimi-Dev-72B 对人工补丁的语义相似度，因此 SWE RL 期间不使用 Docker 执行。8B 的输入上下文从 16K 扩展到 24K，输出保持 16K；14B 使用 32K 输入与 16K 输出。

公开 collection 可以核验多种输入与检查点，但不足以重放完整运行。当前可见工件包括 Stage-1/Stage-2 SFT、SFT-SWE、RL-Math、RL-SWE、RL-RLHF、RM-Training、最终权重、72B 奖励模型和 8B 中间检查点。专门的 IF-RL 与 Code-RL 数据集、精确 verl commit 与配置、策略 rollout 组、奖励分量、动态过滤账本、随机种子及优化器状态仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is the agreement among independent official artifacts. arXiv v2 describes the complete stage order and feedback functions. NVIDIA's final model cards identify Qwen3-8B-Base and Qwen3-14B-Base as the starting weights. The intermediate-checkpoint card names SFT, RLHF, IF-RL, Math-RL, and Code-RL checkpoints and states that the final 8B follows SWE RL. The RM card states that Qwen2.5-CascadeRL-RM-72B is initialized from Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, trained with Bradley-Terry preference learning, and used in the family's RLHF stage.

The data release is also concrete. The official Stage-1 card reports 5,436,618 samples across math, code, science, and general configurations. The Stage-2 card reports 7,797,730 samples across those domains plus tool calling, instruction following, and three SWE tasks. RL-Math reports 14,476 problems; RL-RLHF reports 45,882 prompts; RM-Training reports 81,808 records; RL-SWE publishes prompt, source, instance, golden-patch, and localization fields and explicitly states that SWE RL uses no Docker execution. These are artifact facts, not proof that every record entered every reported run.

The paper's stage ablations are behavioral evidence. For the unified 8B model, reported LiveCodeBench v6 moves from 56.7 after SFT to 67.2 after RLHF and 71.5 after Code RL, then 71.1 after SWE RL; SWE-bench Verified moves from 26.1 after SFT to 37.2 after the final stage. The 14B final model reports 74.6 on LiveCodeBench v6 and 43.1 on SWE-bench Verified. These tables support claims about the trained checkpoints under the paper's evaluation setup, not the correctness, provenance, licensing, or contamination status of the training data.

Evidence remains partial at the release-accounting layer. Current collection viewer counts for Stage-1 and Stage-2 are lower than their dataset-card totals, and the public collection does not visibly supply dedicated IF-RL or Code-RL datasets. The report's statement that the full training-data collection is released therefore needs an immutable file/count/stage crosswalk before it can be treated as an end-to-end reproducibility claim.

最强证据来自多项官方工件之间的相互印证。arXiv v2 说明完整阶段顺序与反馈函数；NVIDIA 最终模型卡确认起始权重为 Qwen3-8B-Base 与 Qwen3-14B-Base；中间检查点卡列出 SFT、RLHF、IF-RL、Math-RL 和 Code-RL 检查点，并说明最终 8B 在 SWE RL 后得到；奖励模型卡则说明 Qwen2.5-CascadeRL-RM-72B 从 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 初始化，以 Bradley-Terry 偏好学习训练，并用于该系列的 RLHF 阶段。

数据发布同样具体。官方 Stage-1 数据卡报告数学、代码、科学与通用配置合计 5,436,618 条样本；Stage-2 数据卡报告 7,797,730 条，除上述领域外还包括工具调用、指令遵循和三类 SWE 任务。RL-Math 报告 14,476 道题；RL-RLHF 报告 45,882 个提示；RM-Training 报告 81,808 条记录；RL-SWE 发布提示、来源、实例、人工补丁与定位字段，并明确说明 SWE RL 不使用 Docker 执行。这些是工件事实，不能证明每条记录都进入了每次报告运行。

论文的阶段消融属于行为证据。对统一 8B 模型，报告中的 LiveCodeBench v6 从 SFT 后的 56.7 上升到 RLHF 后的 67.2、Code RL 后的 71.5，SWE RL 后为 71.1；SWE-bench Verified 则从 SFT 后的 26.1 上升到最终阶段的 37.2。14B 最终模型报告 LiveCodeBench v6 为 74.6、SWE-bench Verified 为 43.1。这些表格支持指定评测设置下的检查点行为主张，却不能证明训练数据的正确性、来源、许可证或无污染。

发布账本层面的证据仍不完整。当前 collection viewer 显示的 Stage-1 与 Stage-2 数量低于各自数据卡总数，公开 collection 也没有明显列出专门的 IF-RL 或 Code-RL 数据集。因此，在获得不可变的文件、数量与阶段对照表之前，报告所称“完整训练数据 collection”不能直接视为端到端可复现证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Sequential domain-wise RL is not new in isolation: the authors' earlier math-to-code work already used a cascade, and RLHF, GRPO, rule-based verification, program execution, and learned judges are established components. The report's distinguishing move is to scale this composition across alignment, instruction following, mathematics, competitive programming, and software repair while exposing intermediate checkpoints and many training inputs.

The direction signal is the explicit match between domain heterogeneity and feedback design. A slow execution verifier does not share the same infrastructure or error profile as a scalar preference model; a constraint checker can reward a formally compliant but poor answer; a patch-similarity judge scales without containers but ceases to be functional verification. Cascade RL makes those differences first-class curriculum decisions instead of hiding them behind one mixed reward label.

The release is unusually inspectable for a frontier report because weights, a scalar RM, intermediate checkpoints, and several data stages are all official artifacts. Its quality signal is disclosure breadth, not benchmark dominance. The remaining gaps--missing dedicated datasets for some described stages, count mismatches, absent rollouts and decisions, and unpinned code--are part of the novelty assessment rather than details to suppress.

逐领域顺序 RL 本身并非全新：作者此前的数学到代码工作已经采用级联，RLHF、GRPO、规则验证、程序执行与学习式评审也都是既有组件。该报告的区别在于把这种组合扩展到对齐、指令遵循、数学、竞赛编程与软件修复，同时公开中间检查点和多类训练输入。

其方向信号是把领域异质性与反馈设计明确对应起来。缓慢的执行验证器与标量偏好模型具有不同基础设施和错误方式；约束检查器可能奖励形式合规但整体质量差的回答；补丁相似度评审无需大量容器即可扩展，却不再等同于功能验证。Cascade RL 把这些差异提升为课程设计的显式决策，而不是藏在统一“奖励”标签下。

对前沿报告而言，这项发布具有较高可检查性，因为权重、标量奖励模型、中间检查点和多个数据阶段都有官方工件。这里的质量信号是披露广度，而不是基准领先。部分报告阶段缺少专门数据集、数量存在差异、rollout 与筛选决定未发布、代码未固定，这些都应作为新意评估的一部分，而不能被隐藏。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No stage has a perfect verifier. The scalar RM is a preference proxy; the paper notes that the highest RewardBench model need not yield the best aligned policy and that out-of-distribution prompts can destabilize RLHF. The IF verifier checks explicit constraints but not overall usefulness, and the authors report degradation from naive use. Math reward checks an extracted endpoint rather than every reasoning step. Code reward inherits test incompleteness and execution nondeterminism. SWE reward is explicitly execution-free, so an alternative correct patch may look dissimilar to the human patch, while a similar patch may still fail repository tests.

Release coverage is incomplete relative to the described pipeline. The checked collection contains RLHF, Math, and SWE RL inputs but no visibly dedicated IF-RL or Code-RL datasets. The Stage-1 and Stage-2 dataset cards report 5,436,618 and 7,797,730 samples, while current viewer counts are lower. Upsampling, file revisions, viewer processing, and model-run membership may explain some differences, but an official reconciliation is unknown. Collection membership alone cannot establish exact use, mixture weight, or snapshot.

Lineage stops before the online learning record. The release does not provide complete policy rollout groups, per-component rewards, log probabilities, dynamic-filter decisions, rejected candidates, seeds, logs, optimizer states, or a record-to-checkpoint manifest. The report names verl but does not pin the exact commit and complete stage configurations. Reproducing the paper therefore requires substantial reconstruction even though intermediate weights are available.

Decontamination and rights evidence are bounded. The paper describes 9-gram filtering for math/code, URL matching for Code RL, and repository-plus-commit exclusion for SWE; exact benchmark revisions and removal ledgers are unknown, and general, instruction, safety, and tool-calling data lack an equivalent corpus-wide audit. Dataset cards declare CC BY 4.0, but upstream attribution, repository-code rights, and generated-response model terms still require record-level review.

Finally, the sequential curriculum is not a guarantee against forgetting. The paper acknowledges that conflicting rewards can overwrite earlier behavior, and its own stage tables contain small regressions alongside gains. Those benchmark changes characterize model behavior under the reported setup; they do not validate dataset quality, verifier calibration, or the release's legal and provenance chain.

任何阶段都没有完美验证器。标量奖励模型只是偏好代理；论文指出，RewardBench 分数最高的模型不一定产生最佳对齐策略，分布外提示还可能使 RLHF 不稳定。IF 验证器检查明确约束，却不检查整体有用性，作者也报告了直接使用带来的退化。数学奖励检查抽取出的终点，而非每一步推理。代码奖励受测试不完备与执行不确定性影响。SWE 奖励明确不执行代码，因此替代性的正确补丁可能与人工补丁不相似，相似补丁也可能无法通过仓库测试。

与报告流水线相比，发布覆盖仍不完整。已检查 collection 包含 RLHF、Math 与 SWE RL 输入，但没有明显列出专门的 IF-RL 或 Code-RL 数据集。Stage-1 和 Stage-2 数据卡分别报告 5,436,618 与 7,797,730 条样本，而当前 viewer 数量更低。上采样、文件修订、viewer 处理和模型运行归属可能解释部分差异，但官方对照仍为 unknown。仅凭 collection 成员身份不能确定精确用途、混合权重或快照。

谱系在进入在线学习记录前中断。发布内容不包含完整策略 rollout 组、各奖励分量、对数概率、动态过滤决定、被拒候选、随机种子、日志、优化器状态或记录到检查点的清单。报告虽然说明使用 verl，却没有固定精确 commit 与完整分阶段配置。因此，即使中间权重已经公开，重现实验仍需大量重建。

去污染与权利证据都有边界。论文说明数学和代码使用 9-gram 过滤、Code RL 使用 URL 匹配、SWE 使用仓库名加 commit 排除；但基准精确修订版和删除账本为 unknown，通用、指令、安全与工具调用数据也没有同等范围的全语料审计。数据卡声明 CC BY 4.0，但上游署名、仓库代码权利与生成模型条款仍需逐条审查。

最后，顺序课程并不保证不会遗忘。论文承认奖励冲突可能覆盖早期行为，分阶段表格也同时存在小幅提升与退化。这些基准变化描述的是报告设置下的模型行为，不能验证数据集质量、验证器校准或发布的法律与来源链条。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, Nemotron-Cascade is useful as a layered audit case. Layer one is the report: it names sources, generators, filtering, stage order, reward functions, and many hyperparameters. Layer two is released training input: several SFT, preference, math, and SWE repositories are downloadable. Layer three is model state: final weights, a 72B RM, and 8B intermediate checkpoints are official. Layer four is evaluation: benchmark tables and cached evaluation materials describe model behavior. Evidence in one layer does not make another complete.

Data builders can reuse the design principle of matching feedback to domain, but should preserve the contract explicitly. An auditable implementation would retain prompt source/revision, teacher and policy revision, all candidates, acceptance/rejection reason, verifier version and output, component rewards, group membership, dynamic-filter decisions, seed, and checkpoint step. It should also distinguish a functional code test from answer matching, constraint checking, preference scoring, or patch similarity.

Auditors can pin every dataset and model revision; independently count rows by configuration; reconcile counts with the paper; check whether dedicated IF-RL and Code-RL inputs are available; sample SFT-to-RL disjointness; replay math extraction and code tests; evaluate the scalar RM out of distribution; and compare execution-free SWE rewards with actual repository test outcomes. Rights and benchmark-overlap checks should be repeated for the reuser's own evaluation suite.

The model scores should not be used as a data-quality proxy. A responsible reuse decision depends on lineage, verifier error, contamination, rights, and whether the released object is a prompt set, supervised response set, preference pair set, policy rollout, or only a model checkpoint.

对 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger 而言，Nemotron-Cascade 适合作为分层审计案例。第一层是报告：它列出来源、生成器、筛选、阶段顺序、奖励函数与多项超参数。第二层是已发布训练输入：多组 SFT、偏好、数学和 SWE 仓库可以下载。第三层是模型状态：最终权重、72B 奖励模型与 8B 中间检查点均为官方发布。第四层是评测：基准表和缓存评测材料描述模型行为。任何一层的证据都不能自动补全另一层。

数据构建者可以复用“让反馈与领域匹配”的设计原则，但必须明确保存契约。可审计实现应保留提示来源与修订版、教师和策略修订版、全部候选、接受或拒绝原因、验证器版本与输出、奖励分量、组归属、动态过滤决定、随机种子和检查点步骤；还应清楚区分功能性代码测试、答案匹配、约束检查、偏好打分与补丁相似度。

审计者可固定每个数据和模型修订版，按配置独立统计行数并与论文对照；检查是否存在专门 IF-RL 与 Code-RL 输入；抽样验证 SFT/RL 不重叠；重放数学答案抽取与代码测试；测试标量奖励模型的分布外表现；把无执行的 SWE 奖励与真实仓库测试结果比较。权利与基准重叠也应针对复用者自己的评测集重新检查。

模型分数不能作为数据质量代理。负责任的复用决定取决于谱系、验证器误差、污染、权利，以及已发布对象究竟是提示集、监督回答集、偏好对集、策略 rollout，还是仅有模型检查点。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep report claims, released dataset files, released weights/checkpoints, and benchmark results in separate ledgers; none proves the others complete.
  • The cascade is RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math RL -> Code RL -> SWE RL, with scalar preference, constraint, answer, execution, and execution-free patch-similarity rewards respectively.
  • The 8B intermediate repository verifies stage order, but the checked collection does not visibly provide dedicated IF-RL or Code-RL datasets.
  • Official Stage-1/Stage-2 card totals differ from current viewer counts; pin revisions and count raw files before quoting corpus size.
  • SWE RL does not execute patches. Treat Kimi-Dev-72B plus Unidiff as a scalable proxy whose agreement with repository tests needs independent measurement.

• 分开记录报告主张、已发布数据文件、已发布权重或检查点以及基准结果；任何一本账都不能证明其他账完整。
  • 级联顺序为 RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math RL -> Code RL -> SWE RL，对应标量偏好、约束、答案、执行与无执行补丁相似度奖励。
  • 8B 中间仓库可以核验阶段顺序，但已检查 collection 没有明显提供专门 IF-RL 或 Code-RL 数据集。
  • 官方 Stage-1/Stage-2 数据卡总数与当前 viewer 数量不同；引用语料规模前应固定修订版并统计原始文件。
  • SWE RL 不执行补丁。应把 Kimi-Dev-72B 与 Unidiff 视为可扩展代理，并独立测量它们与真实仓库测试的一致性。

value.html: SFT combines general-domain, math, code, science, tool-calling, and software-engineering prompts. Named sources include AceReason-Nemotron-1.1 and its math/code mixtures, S1K, Llama-Nemotron post-training data, SWE-Bench-Train, SWE-Fixer-Train, SWE-reBench, SWE-Smith, and public general-domain corpora. RL prompts are stage-specific: preference-data subsets for RLHF, synthetic constraint prompts for IF-RL, filtered AceReason-Math-style problems for Math RL, unit-tested competitive-programming tasks for Code RL, and difficult code-repair instances for SWE RL. Complete immutable per-record source manifests are unknown.

value_zh.html: SFT 结合通用领域、数学、代码、科学、工具调用与软件工程提示。具名来源包括 AceReason-Nemotron-1.1 及其数学/代码混合物、S1K、Llama-Nemotron 训后数据、SWE-Bench-Train、SWE-Fixer-Train、SWE-reBench、SWE-Smith 与公开通用领域语料。RL 提示依阶段而定：RLHF 用偏好数据子集，IF-RL 用合成约束提示，Math RL 用过滤后的 AceReason-Math 风格问题，Code RL 用经单元测试的竞赛编程任务，SWE RL 用困难代码修复实例。完整不可变的逐记录来源清单未知。

value.html: Released SFT artifacts contain domain-configured supervised conversations or task records; the SFT-SWE card documents category, source, messages, generator, patch, and thinking fields. RL-Math releases problems and short answers. RL-SWE exposes source, instance_id, prompt, golden_patch, and original_prompt. RL-RLHF exposes prompts and source/category metadata, while RM-Training is described as preference-training data. These artifacts are training inputs, not a release of complete policy rollout groups, component rewards, or optimizer states.

value_zh.html: 已发布 SFT 产物包含按领域配置的监督对话或任务记录；SFT-SWE 卡片记录 category、source、messages、generator、patch 与 thinking 字段。RL-Math 发布问题与短答案。RL-SWE 暴露 source、instance_id、prompt、golden_patch 与 original_prompt。RL-RLHF 暴露提示与 source/category 元数据，而 RM-Training 被描述为偏好训练数据。这些产物是训练输入，而非完整策略 rollout 组、组件奖励或优化器状态的发布。

value.html: DeepSeek-R1 generates Stage-1 math, code, and science reasoning responses; DeepSeek-R1-0528 generates longer Stage-2 responses and SWE trajectories; DeepSeek-V3-0324 and DeepSeek-V3 generate general-domain thinking/non-thinking responses; Qwen3-235B-A22B generates tool-calling responses. RL experience is generated on-policy by the current Nemotron-Cascade checkpoint. Record-level model revisions, decoding seeds, and all rejected candidates are unknown.

value_zh.html: DeepSeek-R1 生成 Stage-1 数学、代码与科学推理响应；DeepSeek-R1-0528 生成更长的 Stage-2 响应与 SWE 轨迹；DeepSeek-V3-0324 与 DeepSeek-V3 生成通用领域 thinking/non-thinking 响应；Qwen3-235B-A22B 生成工具调用响应。RL 经验由当前 Nemotron-Cascade checkpoint 同策略生成。记录级模型修订、解码种子与全部被拒绝候选未知。

value.html: Two-stage offline SFT is followed by strict on-policy GRPO in verl. Code RL executes generated programs against tests through the AceReason Evaluation Toolkit. SWE SFT and RL use an Agentless-style localization/repair surface, but SWE RL deliberately replaces Docker execution with an execution-free patch-similarity reward. Exact container images, dependency locks, repository snapshots, and full rollout logs are unknown.

value_zh.html: 两阶段离线 SFT 之后在 verl 中进行严格 on-policy GRPO。Code RL 通过 AceReason Evaluation Toolkit 对照测试执行生成程序。SWE SFT 与 RL 使用 Agentless 风格的定位/修复界面，但 SWE RL 有意用无执行的补丁相似度奖励取代 Docker 执行。确切容器镜像、依赖锁定、仓库快照与完整 rollout 日志未知。

value.html: RLHF uses Qwen2.5-CascadeRL-RM-72B, a scalar reward model trained with a Bradley-Terry objective on about 82K preference pairs. IF-RL uses rule-based instruction-constraint verification with dynamic filtering. Math RL extracts a boxed final answer and uses the AceMath rule-based verifier, plus a code-switching penalty. Code RL gives binary reward only when generated code passes all tests. SWE RL combines Unidiff lexical similarity with Kimi-Dev-72B semantic comparison to the human patch; it is an execution-free proxy rather than functional verification.

value_zh.html: RLHF 使用 Qwen2.5-CascadeRL-RM-72B，一个在约 82K 偏好对上以 Bradley-Terry 目标训练的标量奖励模型。IF-RL 使用基于规则的指令约束核验与动态过滤。Math RL 提取 boxed 最终答案并使用 AceMath 基于规则的验证器，外加 code-switching 惩罚。Code RL 仅在生成代码通过全部测试时给予二元奖励。SWE RL 将 Unidiff 词法相似度与 Kimi-Dev-72B 对人工补丁的语义比较结合；它是无执行代理而非功能核验。

value.html: Stage-dependent: preference score for RLHF; satisfaction of stated constraints for IF-RL; extracted-answer equality for Math RL; all provided tests passed for Code RL; and parseable, non-identity patch similarity to a human patch for SWE RL. Universal correctness, process validity, and cross-stage acceptance thresholds are unknown.

value_zh.html: 依阶段而定：RLHF 为偏好分数；IF-RL 为所述约束的满足；Math RL 为提取答案相等；Code RL 为通过全部所提供测试；SWE RL 为可解析、非恒等且与人工补丁相似的补丁。通用正确性、过程有效性与跨阶段接受阈值未知。

value.html: Nemotron-Cascade-8B and Nemotron-Cascade-8B-Thinking are post-trained from Qwen3-8B-Base; Nemotron-Cascade-14B-Thinking is post-trained from Qwen3-14B-Base. The official collection also releases the 8B SFT, RLHF, IF-RL, Math-RL, and Code-RL intermediate checkpoints; the final 8B checkpoint follows SWE RL.

value_zh.html: Nemotron-Cascade-8B 与 Nemotron-Cascade-8B-Thinking 自 Qwen3-8B-Base 训后得到；Nemotron-Cascade-14B-Thinking 自 Qwen3-14B-Base 训后得到。官方集合还发布 8B SFT、RLHF、IF-RL、Math-RL 与 Code-RL 中间 checkpoint；最终 8B checkpoint 在 SWE RL 之后。

value.html: DeepSeek-R1 is used for Stage-1 reasoning data; DeepSeek-R1-0528 is used for Stage-2 math/code/SWE data and difficulty estimation; DeepSeek-V3 variants produce general-domain responses; Qwen3-235B-A22B produces tool-calling responses. Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct filters some general generations, and Kimi-Dev-72B judges SWE patches. There is no single teacher shared across all stages.

value_zh.html: DeepSeek-R1 用于 Stage-1 推理数据；DeepSeek-R1-0528 用于 Stage-2 数学/代码/SWE 数据与难度估计；DeepSeek-V3 变体产生通用领域响应；Qwen3-235B-A22B 产生工具调用响应。Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 过滤部分通用生成，Kimi-Dev-72B 评判 SWE 补丁。无跨全部阶段共享的单一教师。

value.html: Stage 1 trains one epoch at 16K on general-domain data plus thinking-only math, code, and science traces. Stage 2 trains one epoch at 32K, recombining general data with longer reasoning traces, tool calling, instruction following, and SWE localization/repair/test-generation records. Cascade RL then applies RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math RL -> Code RL -> SWE RL, moving from general alignment to specialized domains.

value_zh.html: Stage 1 在 16K 上对通用领域数据外加仅 thinking 的数学、代码与科学轨迹训练一个 epoch。Stage 2 在 32K 上训练一个 epoch，将通用数据与更长推理轨迹、工具调用、指令遵循及 SWE 定位/修复/测试生成记录重组。随后 Cascade RL 应用 RLHF -> IF-RL -> Math RL -> Code RL -> SWE RL，从通用对齐转向专门领域。

value.html: RL uses strict on-policy GRPO: each iteration samples from the current policy and performs one gradient update, with group-normalized rewards, token-level loss, and no KL term. RLHF, IF-RL, Math RL, and Code RL use 8 responses per prompt; SWE RL uses 16. Dynamic filtering and staged response/context-length curricula vary by domain.

value_zh.html: RL 使用严格 on-policy GRPO：每次迭代从当前策略采样并执行一次梯度更新，带组归一化奖励、token 级损失且无 KL 项。RLHF、IF-RL、Math RL 与 Code RL 每个提示使用 8 条响应；SWE RL 使用 16 条。动态过滤与分阶段响应/上下文长度课程依领域而异。

value.html: Stage-specific: 8 responses per prompt for RLHF, IF-RL, Math RL, and Code RL; 16 for SWE RL. Aggregate attempted, discarded, and retained rollout counts are unknown.

value_zh.html: 依阶段而定：RLHF、IF-RL、Math RL 与 Code RL 每个提示 8 条响应；SWE RL 为 16 条。合计尝试、丢弃与保留的 rollout 计数未知。

value.html: Stage-specific: 0.6 for RLHF and IF-RL; Math RL uses 1.0/1.0/0.8 for the 8B length stages and 1.2/1.1 for 14B; Code RL reports model-dependent settings around 0.8-1.2; SWE RL uses 1.0.

value_zh.html: 依阶段而定：RLHF 与 IF-RL 为 0.6；Math RL 对 8B 长度阶段使用 1.0/1.0/0.8，对 14B 使用 1.2/1.1；Code RL 报告约 0.8-1.2 的模型相关设置；SWE RL 使用 1.0。

value.html: General SFT retains original high-quality answers, rejects verifiable-answer mismatches, and uses Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct for auxiliary filtering where ground truth is absent. Math and code SFT use 9-gram benchmark filtering and length bounds. SWE removes repositories in SWE-bench Verified, deduplicates by repository and base commit, and separates easier SFT from harder RL instances by DeepSeek-R1-0528 patch-similarity success. Math RL removes unsuitable, noisy, trivial, and unsolved items; Code RL removes special-judge, weak-test, duplicate, contaminated, trivial, and intractable tasks. Complete rejection ledgers are unknown.

value_zh.html: 通用 SFT 保留原始高质量答案，拒绝可验证答案不匹配，并在无标准答案处使用 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 做辅助过滤。数学与代码 SFT 使用 9-gram 基准过滤与长度界限。SWE 移除 SWE-bench Verified 中的仓库，按仓库与 base commit 去重，并由 DeepSeek-R1-0528 补丁相似度成功将较易 SFT 与较难 RL 实例分开。Math RL 移除不适合、嘈杂、平凡与未解条目；Code RL 移除 special-judge、弱测试、重复、受污染、平凡与难解任务。完整拒绝账本未知。

value.html: Training response limits are stage-specific: RLHF 12K; IF-RL 8K or 16K; 8B Math RL 24K -> 32K -> 40K; Code RL roughly 44K-56K by model; SWE RL outputs 16K with 16K -> 24K input-context extension for 8B and 32K input for 14B. Evaluation commonly uses temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, and up to 64K generation; those evaluation settings are not training rollout settings.

value_zh.html: 训练响应限制依阶段而定：RLHF 12K；IF-RL 8K 或 16K；8B Math RL 24K -> 32K -> 40K；Code RL 按模型约 44K-56K；SWE RL 输出 16K，8B 的输入上下文扩展为 16K -> 24K，14B 的输入为 32K。评测常用 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95 与至多 64K 生成；这些评测设置不是训练 rollout 设置。

value.html: SFT uses AdamW with two length stages. All Cascade RL stages use strict on-policy GRPO in verl, group-normalized rewards, token-level loss, and no KL regularization; reward shaping and sequence-level loss are discussed as stabilization alternatives for weaker reward models. Exact code commit, complete configuration files, hardware totals, seeds, and optimizer states are unknown.

value_zh.html: SFT 使用 AdamW 与两个长度阶段。全部 Cascade RL 阶段在 verl 中使用严格 on-policy GRPO、组归一化奖励、token 级损失且无 KL 正则；奖励塑形与序列级损失被讨论为较弱奖励模型的稳定化替代。确切代码 commit、完整配置文件、硬件总量、种子与优化器状态未知。

value.html: The report gives domain- and stage-level source descriptions and claims a full training-data release. The official collection visibly lists final weights, 8B intermediate checkpoints, the 72B reward model, Stage-1/Stage-2 SFT, SFT-SWE, RL-Math, RL-SWE, RL-RLHF, and RM-Training artifacts. It does not visibly provide dedicated Code-RL or IF-RL datasets. Official dataset cards report 5,436,618 Stage-1 and 7,797,730 Stage-2 samples, while current collection viewer counts are lower; no official crosswalk reconciles paper counts, files, viewer rows, upsampling, or run membership.

value_zh.html: 报告给出领域与阶段级来源描述，并声称完整训练数据发布。官方集合可见列出最终权重、8B 中间 checkpoint、72B 奖励模型、Stage-1/Stage-2 SFT、SFT-SWE、RL-Math、RL-SWE、RL-RLHF 与 RM-Training 产物。它未可见提供专用 Code-RL 或 IF-RL 数据集。官方数据集卡片报告 5,436,618 条 Stage-1 与 7,797,730 条 Stage-2 样本，而当前集合查看器计数更低；无官方对照表调和论文计数、文件、查看器行、上采样或运行成员关系。

value.html: The paper states that SFT and RL prompts are strictly disjoint. Released dataset repositories mainly expose train splits or domain configurations, not immutable stage-to-run manifests. SWE SFT/RL difficulty partitions are described, but exact record-to-checkpoint order, epoch, weight, and inclusion decisions are unknown.

value_zh.html: 论文称 SFT 与 RL 提示严格不相交。已发布数据集仓库主要暴露 train 划分或领域配置，而非不可变的阶段到运行清单。SWE SFT/RL 难度划分有描述，但确切记录到 checkpoint 的顺序、epoch、权重与纳入决策未知。

value.html: Math/code SFT and Math/Code RL use named 9-gram checks; Code RL also uses raw problem URL matching. SWE excludes repositories present in SWE-bench Verified and deduplicates by repository plus base commit. Exact benchmark revisions, matched records, thresholds beyond the stated rules, removal logs, and corpus-wide checks for general, instruction, safety, and tool-calling data are unknown.

value_zh.html: 数学/代码 SFT 与 Math/Code RL 使用具名 9-gram 检查；Code RL 还使用原始问题 URL 匹配。SWE 排除 SWE-bench Verified 中出现的仓库，并按仓库加 base commit 去重。确切基准修订、匹配记录、所述规则以外的阈值、移除日志，以及对通用、指令、安全与工具调用数据的语料范围检查未知。

items: The scalar reward model is an imperfect preference proxy; the paper explicitly notes that the highest RewardBench score need not produce the best aligned policy, and out-of-distribution prompts can destabilize RLHF.
The instruction verifier checks stated constraints rather than overall answer quality; the paper reports alignment degradation under naive IF-RL and discusses reward-hacking risk.
Math reward verifies an extracted endpoint and format/language conditions, not the validity of every reasoning step; extraction failures and equivalent-answer handling can change rewards.
Code reward is only as reliable as the supplied tests; incomplete tests can create false positives, while execution latency shapes which problems remain feasible.

SWE RL compares against a human patch without executing it. Lexical or judge similarity can undervalue alternative correct patches, reward imitation of the reference, or miss repository-level regressions.
Sequential domain training can still forget when reward objectives conflict; the paper acknowledges this case even though its reported benchmark sequence is mostly stable.
Collection membership does not prove exact use, snapshot, mixture weight, or stage membership. Dedicated IF-RL and Code-RL prompt releases were not visible in the checked collection.
Published dataset totals, current viewer counts, upsampling statements, and paper-level counts lack an immutable reconciliation ledger.
Released training inputs and intermediate weights do not include complete policy rollout groups, component rewards, log probabilities, dynamic-filter decisions, seeds, logs, or optimizer states.

Benchmark scores measure model behavior under specified evaluation settings; they do not prove data provenance, trace correctness, verifier calibration, rights compatibility, or absence of contamination.
标量奖励模型是不完美的偏好代理；论文明确指出最高 RewardBench 分数不必产生最佳对齐策略，且分布外提示可使 RLHF 失稳。
指令验证器检查所述约束而非总体答案质量；论文报告朴素 IF-RL 下的对齐退化，并讨论奖励劫持风险。
数学奖励核验提取的端点与格式/语言条件，而非每一步推理的有效性；提取失败与等价答案处理可改变奖励。
代码奖励仅与所提供测试一样可靠；不完整测试可造成假阳性，而执行延迟塑造哪些问题仍可行。
SWE RL 对照人工补丁比较而不执行它。词法或评审相似度可能低估其他正确补丁、奖励模仿参考，或漏掉仓库级回归。
顺序领域训练在奖励目标冲突时仍可能遗忘；论文承认此情形，即使其报告的基准序列大多稳定。
集合成员关系不证明确切使用、快照、混合物权重或阶段成员关系。在已核验集合中未见专用 IF-RL 与 Code-RL 提示发布。
已公布数据集总量、当前查看器计数、上采样陈述与论文级计数缺乏不可变调和账本。
已发布训练输入与中间权重不包括完整策略 rollout 组、组件奖励、对数概率、动态过滤决策、种子、日志或优化器状态。
基准分数度量指定评测设置下的模型行为；它们不证明数据出处、轨迹正确性、验证器校准、权利兼容性或无污染。

value.html: The checked NVIDIA dataset cards declare CC BY 4.0, while released model and reward-model weights use the NVIDIA Open Model License. A blanket dataset license does not by itself resolve upstream attribution, repository-code rights, generated-response model terms, or compatibility across every source record; a machine-readable rights chain is unknown.

value_zh.html: 已核验的 NVIDIA 数据集卡片声明 CC BY 4.0，而已发布模型与奖励模型权重使用 NVIDIA Open Model License。笼统数据集许可本身并不能解决上游署名、仓库代码权利、生成响应的模型条款或跨每条源记录的兼容性；机器可读权利链未知。

value.html: Named public or synthetic prompt source -> domain-specific filtering/decontamination -> teacher response generation for SFT -> two-stage SFT -> scalar-RM RLHF -> constraint-based IF-RL -> answer-verified Math RL -> execution-verified Code RL -> execution-free patch-similarity SWE RL -> released final weights. The 8B intermediate checkpoints make stage order inspectable, but per-record membership, rejected candidates, verifier outputs, policy rollouts, seeds, logs, and optimizer/checkpoint hashes are incomplete.

value_zh.html: 具名公开或合成提示来源 -> 领域特定过滤/去污染 -> 用于 SFT 的教师响应生成 -> 两阶段 SFT -> 标量 RM RLHF -> 基于约束的 IF-RL -> 答案核验的 Math RL -> 执行核验的 Code RL -> 无执行补丁相似度 SWE RL -> 已发布最终权重。8B 中间 checkpoint 使阶段顺序可检查，但逐记录成员关系、被拒绝候选、验证器输出、策略 rollout、种子、日志与优化器/checkpoint 哈希不完整。
